reviewer.independence_note: This is a different-model review within the OpenAI family. It is not an independent-family review and grants no canonical approval.

scope: Read-only review of substantive coverage and claim boundaries for the engineering-hardening specification and its matching delta set. Existing owner anchors were checked only for named-anchor presence.

findings.subject: All 38 requested work items have unique substantive coverage
findings.evidence: The JSON user_work_item_register contains items 1 through 38 exactly once. Patch coverage is V156-EH-16 for 1–10, V156-EH-17 for 11–18, V156-EH-18 for 19–30, V156-EH-19 for 31–36, and V156-EH-20 for 37–38. Each package provides normative requirements, a function-contract refinement, and pending test specifications appropriate to its item group.

findings.subject: Quantitative tank example is dimensioned, conservative, and bounded
findings.evidence: V156-EH-18 states dh/dt=u+d, h in [0,10] m, |d|<=0.1 m/s, u in [-1,1] m/s, 0.05 m sensor error, and 0.10 s sensor age, monitor, and 0.20 s handoff bounds. Its 0.49 m margin equals 0.05 + 1.1*(0.10+0.10+0.20); the 0.49/9.51 measured switching thresholds account for worst-sign sensor error and the remaining 0.44 m outward travel. It defines the delay-dependent recoverable region [1.1D, 10-1.1D], fallback inward net speed, failure cases, assurance-loss behavior, and explicit non-deployment/non-guarantee boundaries.

findings.subject: Authority revocation and uncertain completion are not falsely collapsed into nonexecution
findings.evidence: V156-EH-16 separates pre-commit fencing/cancellation from post-commit containment, compensation, and reconciliation; it also requires monotone lease/fencing epochs and an OUTCOME_UNKNOWN recovery path. V156-EH-04 separately requires that an occurred effect remains recorded when acknowledgment is lost or a postcondition fails, and prohibits replay until reconciliation unless non-duplication is proven. V156-EH-19 blocks new consequential action when immediate revocation cannot be checked, except for separately authorized bounded continuity.

findings.subject: Release admission is explicitly conjunctive and protects the artifact actually consumed
findings.evidence: V156-EH-17 requires valid TUF verification AND valid in-toto policy verification AND identical artifact content identity across stages and final consumption. It blocks failed, missing, stale, and incomplete checks; covers threshold, expiry, downgrade, missing-step, unauthorized-builder, substituted-content, cross-stage-hash, and compromise-recovery cases; and requires receipts that bind the artifact, policies, roots, tools, time, and individual checks.

findings.subject: Both documents preserve truthful completion status
findings.evidence: The header, per-package statuses, test execution_status fields, verification_status object, and promotion boundary consistently distinguish source design from execution. They mark TLA+ creation/model checking/runtime tests/TUF-in-toto implementation/physical simulation/STPA completion/production qualification as pending or not established, and state that bounded checks do not certify unbounded or production behavior.

findings.subject: Delta set is internally consistent with declared owner-extension posture
findings.evidence: The JSON has 20 patches, zero declared new SchemaIDs, new top-level engines, authority sources, or GSL primitives. In every patch, owners equals existing_owners and requirements exactly repeats the invariant requirements. Named predecessor anchors SCHEMA-958DDFB791, SCHEMA-8E127067C8, SCHEMA-A85AF32DF1, and SCHEMA-3884EC4D30 are present in the v15.5 technical source.

bounded_limitations: No executable TLA+ source/configuration, model-check receipt, runtime trace comparison, TUF/in-toto implementation, physical simulation output, STPA analysis result, or production evidence was reviewed or executed; this review cannot establish any of them.

The tank arithmetic was checked from the stated bounds only. It is not a validation of continuous-time reachability, solver error, actual hardware, controller implementation, authenticated interface, or safety case.
Owner review verified the presence of selected named predecessor anchors only; it did not perform exhaustive semantic compatibility analysis of every owner field or candidate canonical document.
This review is within the OpenAI family. Required independent-family review and all release gates remain controlling.
